If there was interest in specifying slot auction ePBS, are there already notes or some early work on it somewhere? Feeling more and more like it would be a useful exercise to go through it in parallel, it's not really blocked by 7732 work and in fact benefits from it, so having the two done concurrently could be nice. I wouldn't expect the same maintainers to do both however (unless they want to), think it would be nice to find people interested in the slot auction version who wouldn't interfere too much with the progress on 7732. I'm interested in this as well. Potuz has done some thinking here. I believe most of the complexity lies in understanding fork choice implications, particularly regarding payload equivocation. I agree that the reveal time to PTC time can be shortened as <@486501030046203915> has been requesting, but I don't think we can move much the others > 2 seconds for attestation propagation also I think is not good for nodes outside the US and Europe This constraint only applies to the winning builder though. For aggregation you still have 4s. For solo proposer, it's the same as today 4s cutoff > 2s attestation was not possible pre merge I agree this point is likely the main blocker For slot auctions the critical time is also the time between reveal and PTC deadline imo, for the problem above that <@135497428882292736> was referring to it would be great if there's any incentive (besides less likely to be reorged) to reveal early but I don't think anyone knows how to do that Yea but timing game will just push that to the boundary which realistically reveal time == ptc deadline. What is worse is PTC dead line only votes for timeliness and block hash so builders will try to sequeeze down to the last ms Working on some timing game gadgets Can do some weird stuff with random end time and scaling penalties but it's kinda messy The problem I see today with the current forkchoice is that there's no incentive to reorg a late Payload that didn't achieve PTC threshold. We won't really know how much of a problem this is until we get to test this and it's not trivial to tweak much

excerpts.author: barnabemonnot
excerpts.content: Hi! If there was interest in specifying slot auction ePBS, are there already notes or some early work on it somewhere? Feeling more and more like it would be a useful exercise to go through it in parallel, it's not really blocked by 7732 work and in fact benefits from it, so having the two done concurrently could be nice. I wouldn't expect the same maintainers to do both however (unless they want to), think it would be nice to find people interested in the slot auction version who wouldn't interfere too much with the progress on 7732.

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: I'm interested in this as well. Potuz has done some thinking here. I believe most of the complexity lies in understanding fork choice implications, particularly regarding payload equivocation. The rest of the mechanism seems well understood (no hard blocker), replacing the proposer committing to a header with committing to a builder ID

excerpts.author: soispoke
excerpts.content:
Yeah this was mentioned before but I agree having a time delta between the commit (to the execution payload content) and reveal time is an issue, would be nice to have some data to back it up. By definition we can’t really know when builders decided not to trade but we can at least easily check:
* The frequency at which MEV rewards exceed issuance rewards
* Bid cancellations' max/median/average values over `3sec` might also be interesting 
Also agree slot auctions solves it.

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
One naive solution here is to move PTC deadline to 6s mark
- 2s attestation
- 4s builder reveal
- 6s PTC

My current node is able to see most of attestations under 800ms

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: I'd be against setting these numbers without hard evidence of forkchoice security. 2s attestation was not possible pre merge so that won't really happen. 2 seconds for attestation propagation also I think is not good for nodes outside the US and Europe. I agree that the reveal time to PTC time can be shortened as <@486501030046203915> has been requesting, but I don't think we can move much the others

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
> 2 seconds for attestation propagation also I think is not good for nodes outside the US and Europe

This constraint only applies to the winning builder though. For aggregation you still have 4s. For solo proposer, it's the same as today 4s cutoff

> 2s attestation was not possible pre merge

I agree this point is likely the main blocker

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: For slot auctions the critical time is also the time between reveal and PTC deadline imo, for the problem above that <@135497428882292736> was referring to it would be great if there's any incentive (besides less likely to be reorged) to reveal early but I don't think anyone knows how to do that
